latest.title: WebOS 1, version 1.02, Build 2 — Smooth shell and reliable updates
highlights: Search opens without moving desktop coordinates; Start stays anchored after repeated Search toggles.
Smooth upward slide and clean closing motion for Start and Quick Settings (Wi-Fi, sound and battery), with reduced-motion support.
Opaque light/dark title bars for Windows Update, Solitaire and other standard app windows.
Update discovery uses the GitHub main-branch feed; invalid feeds, missing notes and ahead-of-deployment releases show recoverable errors.
Complete verified offline installation, post-login checks on each boot and staged updates that preserve the installed desktop.
